controls.title: Explicit External Selection
controls.requirement: The SDK MUST require callers to select external sources, connectors, and target adapters explicitly and MUST NOT infer a hidden upstream or downstream system.

controls.title: Logical Store Separation
controls.requirement: The SDK MUST preserve a logical separation between source stores and cognition stores and MUST NOT merge raw source persistence with cognition persistence into one implicit state boundary.

controls.title: Bounded Own-Data Snapshots
controls.requirement: The SDK MUST capture untrusted values through bounded own-data snapshots and MUST NOT traverse arbitrary inherited or cyclic structures as trusted input.

controls.title: Detached Frozen Accepted Boundaries
controls.requirement: The SDK MUST detach and deeply freeze accepted boundary records before downstream use and MUST NOT expose mutable accepted structures for later mutation.

controls.title: Documented Ingestion Resource Limits
controls.requirement: The SDK MUST enforce documented byte, record, and depth limits during ingestion and MUST NOT accept unbounded source payload expansion.

controls.title: Raw Source Content Omitted by Default
controls.requirement: The SDK MUST omit raw team-memory source content by default and MUST NOT expose raw source content unless a caller chooses an explicit content-bearing path.

controls.title: Explicit Collection Promotion Persistence and Authorization
controls.requirement: The SDK MUST require collection, promotion, persistence, and authorization to remain explicit operations and MUST NOT auto-promote raw source material into authorized cognition.

controls.title: Fail-Closed Authorization Decisions
controls.requirement: The SDK MUST fail closed when authorization policy evaluation is malformed, mutated, or erroneous and MUST NOT treat ambiguous authorization input as an approval.

controls.title: Secret-Safe Boundary Diagnostics
controls.requirement: The SDK MUST emit fixed secret-safe boundary diagnostics for documented top level failures and MUST NOT include live credentials or private source content in those diagnostics.

controls.title: Package Install Surface
controls.requirement: Repository conformance MUST verify that the package declares no production dependency fields and no install lifecycle hooks.

controls.title: Package Content Allowlists
controls.requirement: Repository conformance MUST verify that the packaged artifact contains only the documented allowlisted runtime, specification, and documentation files for the published contract surface.

controls.title: Documented Runtime Matrix
controls.requirement: Repository conformance MUST document and verify the supported Node and operating-system matrix for the reference source tree.

controls.title: Maintained Read-Only Team-Memory Connector
controls.requirement: Repository conformance MUST verify that the maintained team-memory connector preserves documented read-only behavior.

controls.title: Deterministic Reference Behavior
controls.requirement: Repository conformance MUST verify deterministic behavior for the documented reference adapters, conformance fixtures, and contract examples.

controls.title: Authenticated Human Authority
controls.requirement: A production host MUST authenticate actors and trusted human approvals before using this SDK for protected operations.

controls.title: Access Control and Workspace Isolation
controls.requirement: A production host MUST enforce access control and tenant or workspace isolation where required by its deployment.

controls.title: Encryption and Secret Management
controls.requirement: A production host MUST provide encryption, secret storage, rotation, and revocation where required by its threat model and policy.

controls.title: Data Minimization and Retention Handling
controls.requirement: A production host MUST implement data minimization, retention, deletion, and legal-policy handling for the data it collects or persists.

controls.title: Backup Restore and Recovery
controls.requirement: A production host MUST implement backup, restore, corruption detection, and disaster recovery for the systems that matter to its deployment.

controls.title: Durable Cognition-Event Publication Recovery
controls.requirement: A production host MUST supply durable publication recovery when cognition-event delivery matters to its application.

controls.title: Monitoring Abuse Limits and Incident Response
controls.requirement: A production host MUST provide monitoring, abuse limits, dependency response, and incident response appropriate to its deployment.

controls.title: Sensitive Connector Review
controls.requirement: A production host MUST complete connector-specific review before enabling raw or sensitive content flows.

nonClaims.title: Source Truth and Semantic Quality
nonClaims.statement: The SDK does not claim that collected source material is true, complete, well-evidenced, or semantically correct.

nonClaims.title: Caller-Supplied Content Hash Authenticity
nonClaims.statement: The SDK does not claim that a caller-supplied contentHash value is authentic or independently verified.

nonClaims.title: Exactly-Once End-to-End Delivery
nonClaims.statement: The SDK does not claim exactly-once end-to-end delivery across host queues, storage, connectors, or downstream systems.

nonClaims.title: SDK-Supplied Deployment Security
nonClaims.statement: The SDK does not claim to supply deployment authentication, encryption, tenant isolation, or other host security controls by itself.

nonClaims.title: Production Security Certification
nonClaims.statement: The SDK does not claim to certify that a host deployment is secure, compliant, or production-ready.
